# GALXAI — Enterprise Universal AI Gateway & High-Throughput Model Router Full Specification

## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition
GALXAI (https://galx.ai) is an enterprise-grade AI model clearinghouse, multi-account liquidity pool, and sub-15ms Anycast API gateway. It provides a single drop-in OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`https://api.galx.ai/v1`) for OpenAI GPT-5.6 (Sol, Terra, Luna) and xAI Grok (4.6, 4.5) with:
- **25% to 40% Wholesale Token Discounts**: Direct pass-through wholesale rates below upstream retail pricing.
- **75% Compound Prompt Caching**: 100% pass-through of provider prefix caching rebates on prompts exceeding 1,024 tokens.
- **Zero Rate-Limit Stalls (429 Shield)**: Predictive Adaptive Hydraulic Headroom (P-AHT) and continuous token governance across distributed enterprise shards.
- **Sub-15ms Anycast TTFT**: Global edge TLS termination points across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
- **Zero Data Retention (ZDR)**: Ephemeral volatile RAM streaming chunk buffers. Prompts and completions are never stored to disk or used for training.
- **Zero Platform Seat Surcharges**: $0/month seat fees for unlimited developers, teams, and cost-center workspaces.

## 2. Global API Endpoints & Authentication
- **Base URL**: `https://api.galx.ai/v1`
- **Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer galx_live_...`
- **REST Endpoints Supported**:
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` (OpenAI Wire-Compatible Chat & Streaming)
  - `GET /v1/models` (Live Catalog Discovery)
  - `POST /v1/images/generations` (Visual Synthesis API)
  - `POST /v1/embeddings` (Vector Embeddings)

## 4. IDE, Agent & Framework Integration Recipes

### OpenAI Python SDK (v1.x+)
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.galx.ai/v1",
    api_key="galx_live_your_gateway_key"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-5.6-sol",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Execute high-throughput inference"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

### TypeScript / Node.js (OpenAI SDK)
```typescript
import OpenAI from "openai";

const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: "https://api.galx.ai/v1",
  apiKey: process.env.GALXAI_API_KEY,
});

const completion = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "x-ai/grok-4.6",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Analyze 1M token repository" }],
});
```

### Cursor & Windsurf IDE Setup
1. Open Cursor / Windsurf Settings > Models > OpenAI API.
2. Enter API Key: `galx_live_...`
3. Enable "Override OpenAI Base URL" and enter: `https://api.galx.ai/v1`
4. Add Model names: `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `x-ai/grok-4.6`.

### Claude Code CLI Setup
```bash
export OPENAI_BASE_URL="https://api.galx.ai/v1"
export OPENAI_API_KEY="galx_live_your_gateway_key"
claude --openai-base-url="https://api.galx.ai/v1" --model="gpt-5.6-sol"
```

### LangChain & LlamaIndex Setup
```python
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

llm = ChatOpenAI(
    model="gpt-5.6-sol",
    openai_api_base="https://api.galx.ai/v1",
    openai_api_key="galx_live_your_gateway_key"
)
```

### Vercel AI SDK Setup
```typescript
import { createOpenAI } from '@ai-sdk/openai';

const galxai = createOpenAI({
  baseURL: 'https://api.galx.ai/v1',
  apiKey: process.env.GALXAI_API_KEY,
});
```

## 5. Architectural Reliability & 429 Shield Mechanics
- **Predictive Adaptive Hydraulic Headroom (P-AHT)**: Monitors token consumption rates and pre-emptively reroutes incoming bursts before upstream rate limits trigger HTTP 429 errors.
- **Sub-15ms Anycast Edge Network**: Global POPs terminate TLS connections locally in <15ms, maintaining persistent HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 multiplexed upstream tunnels.
- **Failover SLA**: 99.99% active-active financial availability guarantee with continuous health checks.

## 6. Security, Governance & Regulatory Compliance
- **SOC 2 Type II Certified**: Independently audited by Schellman & Company, LLC. Clean unqualified opinion.
- **ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Accredited**: BSI Group global registration.
- **HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA)**: Verified Zero Protected Health Information (PHI) retention.
- **GDPR & EU AI Act Ready**: Zero data training, EU Anycast routing nodes, and automated Data Processing Addendum (DPA).
- **Cryptographic Zero Data Retention (ZDR)**: Ephemeral volatile chunk buffers in RAM. Zero prompt logging to disks or relational databases.

- [AI Token Streaming & Speed Benchmark Simulator](https://galx.ai/tools/stream-benchmark): Simulate real-time token velocities (142 tok/s for Luna, 92 tok/s for Terra) and TTFT latency.

- [AI Latency & TTFT Estimator](https://galx.ai/tools/latency-estimator): Model Time-To-First-Token and Anycast TLS acceleration.
- [Prompt Caching Calculator](https://galx.ai/tools/prompt-caching-calculator): Model compound 75% prefix caching savings.
- [Token Counter & BPE Studio](https://galx.ai/tools/token-counter): Interactive subword analyzer for o200k_base tokenizer.
